edits.old: Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary and the TSD P5 T3.1 table. No foreign-schema table is read (DP-01). Personal data never enters the event payload, the workflow input or the log: a personal field value is masked in a read and replaced by the field name in a log line (BR9).
edits.new:
Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary and the TSD P5 T3.1 table. No foreign-schema table is read (DP-01). Personal data never enters the event payload, the workflow input or the log: a personal field value is masked in a read and replaced by the field name in a log line (BR9).

The keys `extraction_method`, `review_only`, `pattern` and `personal`, and the field codes `owner_name`, `borrower_name`, `guarantor_name` and `account_no`, are not fields or entities in LDM v9 or Data Classification v5. They are keys and values held in `field_definitions` (DF-REF-224) and are recorded in the additions file, not as columns.
